sloka: तेषु प्रविविशे चैव सुग्रीवः सूर्यमण्डलम् ।पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां स्वान्पितऽन्प्रतिपेदिरे ।। ७.११०.२२ ॥
transliteration: teṣu praviviśe caiva sugrīvaḥ sūryamaṇḍalam ।paśyatāṁ sarvadevānāṁ svānpita'npratipedire ।। 7.110.22 ॥

translations.english: Among them, Sugriva entered the solar orb, and all the gods, while watching, attained their own ancestors.
